_hinweis: Malbeschreibungen für Bildlexikon-Einträge, die bisher in keinem Szenenplan vorkamen (für die Strukturbilder, Entscheid Andi Neck 2026-11-24). Keine Szenen; gemalt werden nur die Einzelbilder (bilder_aquarell_figuren.py).

figuren.FIG-BARABBAS: Barabbas: a rough man of about thirty-five with dark unkempt hair and a short beard, in a dark plain robe, his hands tied together in front with a rope.
figuren.FIG-GERASENER: The man called Legion, healed: a man of about thirty with long loose dark hair and a full beard, sitting calmly, now clothed in a plain sand-coloured robe; a broken iron chain lies on the ground beside him.
figuren.FIG-GRUPPE-FISCHER: Fishermen: three men in grey-blue work robes standing on the shore, two of them holding a wet fishing net between them.
figuren.FIG-GRUPPE-HOHER-RAT: The High Council: three older men side by side – a high priest in a white robe with a wrapped white head-band and a small square breastplate of coloured stones, a scribe holding a scroll, and an elder with a long grey beard in a dark blue mantle.
figuren.FIG-GRUPPE-TRAEGER: Four men in simple work robes with coloured sashes carrying a straw mat between them by its four corners, the mat empty.
figuren.FIG-GRUPPE-ZOELLNER: Tax collectors and sinners: three men and one woman in grey-green robes, one man holding a leather money pouch, sitting together at a low table.
figuren.FIG-JESUS-JUNGE: Jesus as a boy of twelve: a slim boy with short dark hair and a round face, no beard, in a cream tunic and a small terracotta-red mantle like the grown Jesus. No halo.
figuren.FIG-KAJAFAS: Caiaphas, the high priest: a stern man of about fifty-five with a dark beard going grey, in the high priest's vestment – a blue robe, a square breastplate with twelve coloured stones, a white turban with a golden plate on the forehead.
figuren.FIG-LAZARUS: Lazarus: a man of about thirty-five with short dark hair and a short beard, standing at the opening of a rock tomb whose round stone is rolled away, still wrapped in linen bands, a cloth hanging from his head.
figuren.FIG-LEVI: Levi (Matthew), the tax collector: a man of about thirty-five with short dark hair and a trimmed beard, in a light robe with a grey-green mantle, sitting at a small toll table with stacks of coins.
figuren.FIG-LIEBLINGSJUENGER: The disciple whom Jesus loved: a young man of about twenty, short curly dark hair, clean-shaven, gentle face; an earth-coloured belted disciple's robe with a light cream mantle and a walking staff; a small red heart drawn beside him as his sign.
figuren.FIG-NIKODEMUS: Nicodemus: a dignified man of about sixty with a neat grey beard, wearing a night-blue robe and a night-blue turban (no hood), holding a small lit clay oil lamp.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-AEHREN: Three ripe golden ears of grain on green stalks.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-AXT: An axe with an iron head and a wooden handle.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-AXT-WURZEL: An axe leaning against the root of a leafy tree.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-BACKTROG: A low round wooden kneading trough without legs, pale dough risen high above its rim with little bubbles, a small heap of flour beside it.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-FEIGENBAUM-BLAETTER: A fig tree with a broad green crown of large lobed leaves and no fruit at all.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-FESSEL: A rope fetter: a short length of blue-grey cord tied in a firm knot.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-FUCHS: A fox's head peering out of an earth hole.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-GERSTE: Barley measured into a striped woollen cloak with fringes, its corners knotted together at the top into a bundle (not a sack); loose elongated barley grains in front and one bearded ear of barley on top.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-GRUBE: A dark hole in the ground, seen slightly from above.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-KORB-FISCHE: A woven basket with one small fish in it.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-KRANKENMATTE: A sick person lying on a straw mat, in a pale grey robe, with short red fever lines above the head.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-LEINENBINDEN: Linen burial wrappings lying on a stone bench inside a rock tomb, and set apart from them a rolled-up face cloth; dark tomb niche behind.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-MUEHLSTEIN: A large round grey millstone with a hole in the middle.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-MYRRHE: Fragrant spices: a clay amphora jar, with a small green sprig of herbs beside it at the lower right.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-OBERGEWAND: A mantle: a brown woollen cloak, open at the front, with folds and a light stripe, blue-and-white tassels at its corners.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-OPFERKASTEN: An offering box: a wooden chest with a straight, trumpet-shaped bronze funnel on top, open upwards, and one coin falling into it.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-RICHTERSTUHL: A judgment seat: a folding chair with crossed X-shaped legs, a back rest and a red cushion, standing on a raised stone platform with two steps.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-RIZINUS: A tall castor-oil plant with large hand-shaped lobed leaves forming a canopy, red stems and red leaf veins, casting a broad shadow on the ground beneath; no flowers.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-SALBOEL: A slender pale alabaster flask with a wine-red stopper, faint lines of fragrance rising from it.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-SIEGEL: A large round tomb stone with a cord stretched across it, fixed by a round red wax seal.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-TAFEL: A wooden sign board nailed to the top of a wooden post, with a few unreadable lines of writing.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-TAUFMUSCHEL: A ribbed scallop shell with a fan-shaped edge and little ears at the hinge, held in a hand, water pouring from it in a stream into a river below.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-WEINSCHLAUCH: A new wineskin: a plump, tightly filled dark-brown goatskin with tied-off leg stumps and a cord around the neck.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-WEINSCHLAUCH-RISS: An old wineskin: a grey, wrinkled leather skin with a long tear, red wine dripping out of it.
figuren.FIG-ORT-GOLGOTA: Golgotha: a bare rocky hill with three empty wooden crosses, the middle one slightly taller with a small sign board at the top; no bodies.
figuren.FIG-ORT-ROM: Rome: a classical building with columns and a triangular pediment, with a small eagle at the lower right.
figuren.FIG-ORT-SILOAM: The Pool of Siloam: a stone pool with steps leading down into clear blue water; no colonnade.
figuren.FIG-ORT-TEICH: The Pool of Bethesda: a walled stone pool with water and steps leading down into it, colonnades with columns around it in the background, a stone pavement in front.
figuren.FIG-ORT-TOR-ENG: The narrow gate: a city gate with two towers and battlements and only a very narrow dark gap between them, one small person squeezing through; a narrow path leads up to it.
figuren.FIG-PHILIPPUS: Philip: a slender man of about thirty with short brown hair and a short beard, in an earth-coloured belted disciple's robe with a lilac mantle, holding a long wooden staff topped by a small golden cross.
figuren.FIG-ROLLE-FEIND: The enemy in the parable: a man of about forty with a full dark beard and no head covering, in an earth-brown mantle, scattering seed by night; a small weed sprig drawn on his chest as his sign.
figuren.FIG-ROLLE-FREUND: A friend asking at night: a man of about thirty-five in a simple brown robe with a light belt, no head covering, knocking at a closed house door; three loaves of bread and a crescent moon drawn above him as his sign.
figuren.FIG-ROLLE-GEHEILTER-BLINDER: The man born blind, healed: a young man of about twenty-five with short dark hair and a short beard, eyes wide open and joyful, in a plain sand-coloured robe with a brown belt, holding an empty begging bowl; a small open eye drawn above the bowl.
figuren.FIG-ROLLE-HIRTE: A shepherd: a weathered man of about forty in a rough brown wool cloak with a wooden crook, a large white sheep standing close beside him.
figuren.FIG-ROLLE-LOHNARBEITER: A day labourer: a wiry man of about thirty in a short ochre work tunic with a belt, holding a hoe.
figuren.FIG-ROLLE-MAGD: A servant girl at the door: a young woman of about twenty with a light head cloth and a blue sash, standing at a wooden door.
figuren.FIG-ROLLE-MITGEKREUZIGTER: A man crucified alongside Jesus: a man of about thirty in a plain grey-brown loincloth-length robe, arms outstretched on a simple wooden cross, head bowed; no sign board, no halo.
figuren.FIG-ROLLE-PHARISAEER: A Pharisee: a bearded man of about fifty, head uncovered, in a grey-blue robe with a striped white prayer shawl over the shoulders, a small black prayer box on his forehead and tassels on the hem.
figuren.FIG-ROLLE-SAMARITANERIN: The woman from Samaria: a woman of about thirty-five in a petrol-blue robe with a sand-coloured head cloth, carrying a large clay water jar on her hip.
figuren.FIG-ROLLE-TAUBER: A deaf man: a man of about forty with short hair and a short beard in a grey-green robe; next to his head a small ear sign crossed out with a red line.
figuren.FIG-ROLLE-TEMPELWACHE: A temple guard: a man of about thirty in a dark blue-grey robe with a belt, holding a wooden staff in one hand and a burning torch in the other.
figuren.FIG-ROLLE-VERWALTER: A steward: a man of about forty-five with a trimmed beard, in a grey-green robe with a light wrap, holding a sheet with coins on it to pay out the wages.
figuren.FIG-ROLLE-ZWEITER-BESESSENER: The second possessed man: a man of about thirty with long loose reddish-brown hair and a full beard, in a plain reddish-brown robe; behind him a dark smoky shadow without a face.
figuren.FIG-SIMON-KYRENE: Simon of Cyrene: a strong man of about forty with dark skin, short curly hair and a short beard, in a field labourer's knee-length tunic, carrying a heavy wooden cross beam on his shoulder.
figuren.FIG-ZEBEDAEUS: Zebedee: an older fisherman of about sixty with a grey beard, in a grey-blue work robe, sitting in a small wooden boat mending a fishing net.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-ALMOSEN: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: an open upturned hand and, next to it, a coin.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-AUSLIEFERN: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: an open upturned hand and, next to it, a short loop of heavy iron chain.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-AUSSCHLUSS: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: a small stone synagogue house with a Torah scroll above its door, and a red prohibition sign at the lower right.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-AUSTREIBEN: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: a dark, smoky, faceless shadow drifting out of the picture, with a clear curved arrow pointing outwards away from it.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-BERUEHREN: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: a woman's hand reaching out and touching the hem of a terracotta-red mantle, with a few short fine light strokes around the fingertips.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-BLUT-UND-WASSER: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: two small drops side by side, one red and one blue.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-EXIL: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: a winding path leading away from a small walled town, with a solid dark arrow pointing away and a dashed arrow curving back towards the town.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-FEUERZUNGEN: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: a small flame hovering above a person's head. Ordinary people, not Jesus: short hair or a plain head cloth, plain earth-coloured robes, no white robe with a red mantle.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-HAENDE-WASCHEN: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: two open hands held side by side palms up, with water drops falling onto them.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-HAND-VERDORRT: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: a raised open hand, and at its lower right a small wilted, drooping flower.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-HOCHZEIT: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: a festive table with bread, a jug and cups, and above it a green garland with small red flowers hanging in a curve. Ordinary people, not Jesus: short hair or a plain head cloth, plain earth-coloured robes, no white robe with a red mantle.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-KUSS: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: the formal greeting kiss of the ancient Near East, not romantic. Two bearded grown men in plain earth-coloured robes and head cloths, standing, one with a hand on the other's shoulder, leaning in to kiss his cheek. No woman, no couple, no lips or heart, no embrace of lovers. Ordinary people, not Jesus: no white robe with a red mantle.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-LEUCHTEN: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: a small clay oil lamp with a bright flame, and a cluster of little sparkles at the lower right.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-NICHT-HINDERN: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: a raised open hand with a red prohibition circle over it.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-OHRFEIGE: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: a face with squeezed-shut eyes and a reddened cheek, and next to it an open hand with short swing and impact lines; no blood. Ordinary people, not Jesus: short hair or a plain head cloth, plain earth-coloured robes, no white robe with a red mantle.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-SCHLAFEN: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: three blue letters «Zzz» floating upwards, getting larger.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-SCHREIBEN-ERDE: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: a patch of smooth sand with a few wavy lines drawn in it by a finger; no letters.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-STAUB-ABSCHUETTELN: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: a sandalled foot and, beside it, a small puff of dust blowing away.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-TOETEN: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: one man raising a sword in his lifted hand, the other man falling backwards with arms thrown up and a frightened face; no blood, no wound. Ordinary people, not Jesus: short hair or a plain head cloth, plain earth-coloured robes, no white robe with a red mantle.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-TOTENKLAGE: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: a woman in a head cloth clasping both hands above her head, mouth wide open in a cry, eyes squeezed shut, tears on both cheeks. Ordinary people, not Jesus: short hair or a plain head cloth, plain earth-coloured robes, no white robe with a red mantle.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-UNREINER-GEIST: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: a dark, swirling, smoky shadow with no face.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-VERBORGEN: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: a cut-away view of a small house with a closed, bolted door, inside a person kneels alone praying with folded hands. Ordinary people, not Jesus: short hair or a plain head cloth, plain earth-coloured robes, no white robe with a red mantle.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-WUNDMALE: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: an open palm facing the viewer with one small dark-red dot in its centre.
